description: Database configuration / drift ops view: AUTO_SHRINK/CLOSE, PAGE_VERIFY, RCSI/SI, stats flags, Query Store state, delayed durability/ADR, scoped optimizer settings (MAXDOP/CE/parameter sniffing/hotfixes). Collector: mssql_database_configuration (300s).

targets.expr: count((mssql_database_query_store_actual_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1) or (mssql_database_query_store_readonly_reason{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0)) or vector(0)
max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_page_verify_option{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", db!="tempdb"} != 2)

panels.title: Query Store Actual / Desired / Readonly Reason

targets.expr: max by (instance, db) ((mssql_database_query_store_actual_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1) or (mssql_database_query_store_readonly_reason{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0))

panels.description: MAXDOP: parallel worker limit (0 = inherit server default). Legacy CE / Parameter Sniffing / Optimizer Hotfixes: 0 = OFF, 1 = ON.

targets.expr: max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_scoped_configuration{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", configuration="MAXDOP"})
max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_scoped_configuration{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", configuration="PARAMETER_SNIFFING"})

panels.title: Scoped Configuration by Database

title: Collector database_configuration
